items.title: It’s fixed! №116
items.summary: Today, we’ve rounded up and will be covering some of the fixes and improvements that we’ve made to the game today and over the past weeks. If you’d like to catch up on every fixed bug, then be sure to check…

items.title: Update 2.57.1.52
items.summary: A bug that sometimes caused destroyed objects to appear intact for players who joined the battle in-progress has been fixed.

items.title: Update 2.57.1.50
items.summary: A bug in the hit analysis menu that sometimes caused armor elements the shell hit to not be highlighted has been fixed.

items.title: Work-In-Progress: The M7 Tank
items.summary: Today we’re very pleased to share a new work in progress vehicle with you, currently being crafted by War Thunder artists. This is the American M7 medium tank, a project developed right alongside the Sherman.

items.title: Update 2.57.1.48
items.summary: The minimal radar indicator (without a full set of the radar control buttons around it) now has two more buttons: to switch between the radar and IRST and to switch to ESM mode.
